steps.description:
Design and program a robot/system/game.

The program designed by you must have all the following:-

Concept to include:
1. Variables
- Must perform changes to variable values during execution (i.e. variable should not just store a value and remain fixed throughout)

2. List
- Should contain more than 1 item in a list
- Should not just simply display the whole list. Must at least read an individual item from the list or perform update on list values during execution.

3. Function
- Should not have just one block in a function.
- Functions are highly recommended for a repeatedly executed groups of codes or to breakdown long codes into meaning tasks (one function per task)

4. Random Numbers
- Use the random number to give your code random/unpredictable outcome (i.e. to avoid hard coding)

Logic structure to include:
1. if with else if or else
2. Nested if or loop
3. AND or OR (but can be replaced by 1/2)
4. repeat until or while with conditions (i.e. not just while true)

Sensors to include:
- 1 x Motor Driver
- 1 x Ultrasonic Sensor
- 1 x Colour Sensor
- 2 x Button Sensors
- 1 x Buzzer Sensor- 1 x LCD screen
Create a flowchart of the previous step
